title: CareerOrbit
summary: A career workflow platform exploring how job discovery, application preparation and review can connect in one workspace.
problem: Job discovery, documents and application tracking often live across disconnected tools.
approach: Customized and tested n8n workflows, configured Supabase tables and CV storage, integrated APIs and iterated on workflow outputs.
contribution: Workflow customization, Supabase configuration, integration testing, troubleshooting and documentation.

title: TechFarming
summary: A B.Tech agricultural-rover research project, co-authored in IJESAT in 2023, followed by a connected-agriculture web-platform extension.
problem: Soil-moisture checks and plant-health inspection can require repeated manual fieldwork. The academic project explored remote sensing and camera-based cotton-leaf disease classification.
approach: The 2023 paper describes a remotely controlled rover with a robotic arm, soil-moisture sensor and live camera. Its MATLAB image-analysis pipeline uses K-means segmentation, GLCM features and SVM classification. Later web-platform work added accounts, device registration and sensor-report history.
contribution: Co-author of the 2023 research paper and contributor to the B.Tech hardware/software project. Subsequently contributed to supporting web-platform enhancements, integration testing, troubleshooting and documentation. The publication describes the team’s work; it does not assign individual ownership of each subsystem.

gallery.caption: Later TechFarming web-platform extension running locally; this screenshot is separate from the 2023 rover research and does not verify a physical sensor connection.

publication.title: Design and Development of Rover with Robotic Arm-based Soil Moisture Sensor and Live Camera for Plant Health Monitoring
publication.authors: K. Prem Sagar, Siripaka Rakesh, P. Sathish Reddy, Lungchuingam and G. Abhinav Kumar
publication.note: The paper documents a team research prototype and MATLAB demonstrations. It does not establish that the current web application runs the classifier, controls the rover or receives live readings from the original hardware.

phases.title: 2023 · Academic rover research
phases.description: Robotic-arm soil-moisture sensing, live-camera plant monitoring and a MATLAB cotton-leaf classification pipeline, documented in the co-authored paper.

phases.title: Later · Web-platform extension
phases.description: React/Express/MySQL account and device workflows, validated reporting APIs and reading history. Physical hardware integration and classifier deployment require separate verification.
